title: revision-with-receipts
intention: The librarian's FIFTH tenure behaviour, beside crossing honesty, provenance append, promotion and lazy decay: a node proven wrong keeps its residence and carries its wrongness at every later read, and a turn whose answer has since changed can name the earlier question it revises. REFUTATION IS AN INPUT, NEVER A DISCOVERY — it arrives as a stated correction at the chat surface (or as a re-shelved passage superseding an earlier one) and the loop's job is to honour it forever after at read, never to go looking for one. Judged in _label_evidence beside decay: arithmetic at read, no clock, no daemon, no generate spent on deciding truth.
why: Akien, 2026-08-10, the sentence the node exists for: 'the importance of things proven wrong does persist. that's experience. but it must carry that it's proven wrong when revisited.' And the frame that makes it ordinary machinery rather than an error path: 'contradiction will happen. it happens inside my head all the time and has to be resolved.' The lived symptom today: an earned node that becomes WRONG has no path — tenure handles corroboration (attestations) and neglect (decay), and nothing at all handles being mistaken, so the librarian would go on answering from a fact it has been told is false. Measured context, CairnCommons/notes/2026-08-10-persistent-chatbot-field-survey.json: update-and-invalidation, not recall, is the step production memory systems measurably lose on (97.8% of 10,134 entries junk after 32 days in one independent audit), and it is the one place the librarian's tenure loop was already standing without this behaviour. Traces to Telos aim 4 (build something that thinks the way Akien does) and Law 7 (a record of truth may never collapse an error into a coherent shape — which is exactly what deleting a refuted node would do).

falsifier.proves_red: DONE when a node the librarian once answered from can be retired by a later crossing, and a subsequent walk returns that node PRESENT, LABELLED, AND NOT COUNTED, with the correction reachable from it — and when a turn whose answer has since changed can name the earlier question it revises. RED on any of: (1) a refuted node is deleted, or its content or birth provenance is rewritten (invalidate-don't-delete failed, Law 7); (2) a refuted node still counts as evidence toward RESOLVED; (3) a hypothesis-standing node retires an earned node (a guess outvoting earned knowledge); (4) a node refutes itself, or a same-crossing mint retires anything (crossing honesty broken at the new behaviour); (5) a revision is announced without naming the earlier question it revises, or naming a node the walk never held (minted attribution wearing a bibliography — the defect charter falsifier (13) already pins for summaries); (6) the model is asked WHICH SIDE IS TRUE (the host back in the answer path — a refutation is a recorded input, never a generated verdict). WRONG-INTENT TELLS, two and opposite: no refutation ever fires in live use (decorative — the same wrong-shape the charter watches for with 'every node still hypothesis weeks into live use'), or a refutation storm where nodes retire each other (the standing gate not holding). The one question no instrument in this build can answer — was a refutation ITSELF wrong — is Akien's, by his own word at the design session, and is what the WATCHME routes to him.

how: BORROWED WHOLE FROM cairn/machines/ruling's supersession door (grown 2026-08-02), cited not grafted: 'retires by stamping the CONFIRMED successor — never the retired record, which stays on disk byte-identical, red under verify, and visible in list, but no longer OPEN.' Its refusals transfer nearly one-for-one — empty evidence refused, self-supersession refused, doubled retirement refused — and the sharpest one, 'an unconfirmed successor cannot outvote his signature', becomes STANDING GATES REFUTATION POWER: a born-hypothesis mint cannot retire an earned node. Crossing honesty extends unchanged: a refutation minted during a crossing cannot retire anything in that same crossing. WHERE BYTE-IDENTITY DOES NOT TRANSFER, AND WHY: a ruling packet is Akien's signed act, so its bytes are the point; a library node's `standing` is already a system-mutable ledger column that promotion writes. What transfers is the invariant underneath — the corpse is never deleted, its content and birth provenance are never rewritten, it stays visible in the walk. So refutation writes standing='refuted' through the SAME owner-gated update face promotion uses (db_domain's second write face) and APPENDS the refuter's id plus its evidence into provenance, the append pattern charter edge (b) already established for attestations. One write face, one owner, no second store. THE RECEIPTS HALF NEEDS NO NEW FIELD AND NO NEW EVENT: _tenure_on_resolution (loop.py:164) already returns the touched node_ids in every RESOLVED verdict, and every node carries provenance.question (loop.py:238) — so 'when you asked X I told you Y, since then Z' is a reader over what is already on disk. 'I was wrong' and 'I have something new' are one mechanism read from two sides.
